question: Is there a discount code or a good deal on the Aurzen ZIP Pro projector right now?
query: Aurzen ZIP Pro projector discount code deal price October 2026

rec.answer:
**Yes—there’s a sale on the ZIP Pro, plus a coupon worth trying.** Based on the supplied October 2026 results:

- **Confirmed advertised price: $579.99 at Aurzen**, down from $629.99—a **$50 saving (about 8%)**, with no code needed. [Aurzen product page](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-zip-pro-full-hd-portable-projector)
- **Try code `CJ10` for 10% off.** Dealectric reports testing it in Aurzen’s cart on October 25 and lists **$57.99 off the ZIP Pro**, with an expiry of January 30, 2027. However, it also says the code **doesn’t combine with automatic sale prices**, so don’t assume another 10% comes off $579.99—compare the final checkout totals. [Coupon report](https://dealectric.com/aurzen-zip-pro-tri-fold-1080p-projector)

**My recommendation:** Start with Aurzen’s $579.99 listing, try `CJ10`, and keep whichever checkout price is lower. I haven’t independently verified the code.

Also, the **$250–$280 deals** in the results are for the **original ZIP, not the ZIP Pro**; the “up to 60% off” sale headline doesn’t establish that discount for the Pro.
